summary: Keep a runtime-created mission definition source canonical for the same revision, including affected-tree rebuilds.

replay.detail: The retained mission definition source uses the existing canonical claim order when its revision matches the projected minimal run. Definition revision and state are not elected or changed; existing affected-tree and full-replay paths remain.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger or storage-version change.

rules.detail: Claim admission, person authority, idempotency keys, run state and managed transaction guards are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client schema or API change. Identical runtime-created revisions use the same canonical claim order already used for published mission revisions.

downtime.detail: No restart or startup migration is required by the change. Existing full replays retain their work and writer lifetime.

manual.detail: No manual database repair or new operational command is required.

recovery.detail: A definition retaining the later duplicate source can be repaired even when revision history already points to the canonical source. The pointer update shares the projection transaction; other revision history and run state are retained.
